text: When a pet dies, their membership has to stop, along with reminders, refills and future visits. The wrap-up does it all at once.
Remember: always accept the wrap-up. If you close it, the membership keeps billing.
Maria called to say Pepper passed away at home. On his chart, click Deactivate.
Scout lists everything it will stop for Pepper.
His Golden membership is cancelled and settled. Under the membership agreement there's no partial refund, so the unused part is kept. If more had been used than paid, it would be charged here.
Auto-ships, reminders, refills, follow-ups and future appointments are stopped too.
Pepper's chart now says Inactive patient, passed away, and his membership heart is gone.

At a euthanasia visit, the estimate already includes this settlement, and checkout opens the same wrap-up. The most common mistake is closing the wrap-up without accepting. Remember: always accept the wrap-up. If you close it, the membership keeps billing.
